name: pdf-client-report
description: Turn a metrics CSV into this week's client report: a one-page Friday PDF with what moved and what to do next.

interface.shortDescription: Write this week's client report as a one-page PDF
interface.longDescription: Draft a Friday client one-pager from a metrics CSV. The plugin computes what moved, suggests what to do next, and exports a reviewable PDF. It does not typeset arbitrary chat text.
defaultPrompt: Write this week's client report from this CSV.
Turn this export into a Friday client PDF.
Make the weekly client one-pager for Acme.
